parameters.query:
-- One row per clinic with billable shows in the period just closed.
--
-- rate_cents comes off the EVENT, not the clinic. If a rate changed
-- mid-period, each show bills at what it was worth on the day -- which is
-- the only way an invoice stays reproducible a year later.
WITH period AS (
  SELECT (date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '1 month')::date AS p_start,
         (date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '1 day')::date   AS p_end
)
SELECT b.clinic_id,
       c.business_name,
       c.currency,
       c.minimum_cents,
       p.p_start,
       p.p_end,
       count(*)                                    AS shows,
       sum(b.rate_cents)                           AS subtotal_cents,
       array_agg(b.appointment_id ORDER BY b.starts_at) AS appointment_ids
FROM billable_events b
JOIN clinics c USING (clinic_id)
CROSS JOIN period p
WHERE b.state = 'billable'
  AND b.outcome = 'attended'
  AND b.starts_at::date BETWEEN p.p_start AND p.p_end
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM disputes d
         WHERE d.appointment_id = b.appointment_id
           AND d.resolved_at IS NULL)
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6
HAVING count(*) > 0;

-- Draft, never sent. An invoice is a claim on somebody's money; the system
-- prepares it and a person sends it.
INSERT INTO invoices
  (invoice_id, clinic_id, period_start, period_end, shows_count,
   subtotal_cents, adjustment_cents, total_cents, status)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3::date, $4::date, $5, $6, $7, $8, 'draft')
ON CONFLICT (clinic_id, period_start, period_end) DO UPDATE
   SET shows_count      = EXCLUDED.shows_count,
       subtotal_cents   = EXCLUDED.subtotal_cents,
       adjustment_cents = EXCLUDED.adjustment_cents,
       total_cents      = EXCLUDED.total_cents
   WHERE invoices.status = 'draft'   -- never rewrite one already sent
RETURNING invoice_id, total_cents;

-- Attach the events to the invoice so a disputed line can be traced back to
-- the appointment, the booking source, and the recording.
UPDATE billable_events
   SET state = 'invoiced',
       invoice_id = $1
 WHERE appointment_id = ANY(string_to_array($2, ','))
   AND state = 'billable';
